statement:
∀ (s a b C : ℝ) (u d : KdVPlan.Path), a≤b → 0≤C →
KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → KdVPlan.ContH s a b d → KdVPlan.UB s a b d C → u a=0 →
(∀ t∈Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r=>u r k) (d t k) t) →
KdVPlan.UB s a b u (C*(b-a))
proof:
intro s a b C u d hab hC hu hd hdb hua hder
have hp := yui_aux_0027 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 s a b C d hab hd hdb
intro t ht
have heq : KdVPlan.timeInt a t d=u t := by
  funext k
  have hcu := yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 s a b u hu k
  have hcd := yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 s a b d hd k
  have hsub : Icc a t ⊆ Icc a b := Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2
  have hi := yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t _ ht.1 (hcd.mono hsub)
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le ht.1 (hcu.mono hsub)
    (fun r hr => hder r ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans_le ht.2⟩ k) hi
  change (∫ r in a..t, d r k)=u t k
  simpa [hua] using h
have hb := hp.2 t ht
rw [heq] at hb
exact ⟨hb.1,hb.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith [ht.2]) hC)⟩
